Refund Policy
How refunds work for Nexor Premium and other paid features.
Yearly plan charge — the Yearly plan charges ₹1,218 once, upfront, covering 12 months of Nexor Premium (equivalent to ₹49/month for the first 3 months plus ₹119/month for the remaining 9). This is a one-time charge and is non-refundable once the payment is successfully processed, except where required by law.

Monthly plan charges — the Monthly plan charges ₹119.00 every month with no intro discount. If you're charged after you already cancelled, or charged in error, contact us within 7 days of the charge and we'll investigate and refund if the charge was incorrect.

Cancelling stops future charges only — cancelling your subscription stops it from renewing again; it does not refund the period you've already paid for. You keep Premium features until the end of the period you already paid for.

Accidental or duplicate payments — if Cashfree shows you were charged twice for the same period, or a payment failed but money was still deducted by your bank, reach out to Priority Support with your payment ID and we'll refund the duplicate/failed charge.

How refunds are paid — approved refunds are issued back to the original payment method via Cashfree, and typically take 5–7 business days to reflect depending on your bank.

How to request one — open Priority Support (Settings → Priority Support) or contact our Help Center with your payment ID and the reason for your request.
Last updated: —
Subscription & Billing
Auto-renewal, cancellation, and billing terms for Nexor Premium.
What you're buying — Nexor Premium is a subscription: verified badge, priority support, content boost, a 4-day platform-wide promotion at signup, story rewatch insights, and a custom accent color. You can choose between two plans.

Yearly plan — ₹1,218 charged once upfront, covering 12 months (equivalent to ₹49/month for the first 3 months plus ₹119/month for the remaining 9). Renews yearly at ₹1,218 unless cancelled.

Monthly plan — ₹119.00 charged every month with no intro discount. Renews monthly unless cancelled.

Auto-renewal — your card/UPI is not charged again automatically by us mid-cycle beyond what Cashfree processes for each billing date; you'll keep access as long as payments succeed.

Cancelling anytime — you can cancel from Settings → Nexor Premium at any time. Cancelling stops the next renewal; it does not end your current paid period early.

Price changes — if we ever change either plan's price, we'll notify active subscribers in-app before it takes effect on their next billing date.

Pricing currency — all charges are processed in Indian Rupees (₹). Prices shown in any other currency in the app are a live estimate only, calculated from a real daily exchange rate for your reference — the actual charge and any currency conversion is handled by your bank/card network, which may apply its own fee or rate.

Failed payments — if a renewal payment fails, Premium features (including the verified badge granted through this subscription) may be paused until payment succeeds.

See also our Refund Policy for how refunds are handled.
